items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Let’s see, that would have been with Jo Jones.

ctx.x: Here’s one, seven sides recorded for Jubilee, about the same time, somewhere in the late ‘40’s, early ‘50’s. It says “No details.” “Up a Lazy River,” “I Can’t Give You Anything But Love,” “Dancing on the Ceiling,” “Happiness is a Thing Called Joe,” “September Song,” “St. Louis Blues” “I Get a Kick Out of You.” Any recollection of where that might have been?
Let’s see, that would have been with Jo Jones. I don’t remember.
